title: Standing work: nitrogen ice of the Node Gamma Ice Belt into storage at Node Gamma Relay Station (same system, no jump)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-24 05:48 UTC (orders ENT-085 block ZERO: gather iron only where a ship's training needs it; P1: no empty burn; rules F8, F23). 56 Voidborn miners stand at Mining 10 to 13 (table ship_skills), past the class card's goal of 10, and flew the home iron fields (Hamal 31, Schedar 15) while iron stands above its max. 37 of them carry an Ice Harvester I (table ship_modules). This belt read nitrogen ice 44,984 of 50,000 (table readings, 05:23 UTC) in the station's own system, so a run flies no jump: its fuel is two in-system legs. Grazers only on record there (rime-grazer 3, pressblister 3, table herds). Nitrogen ice is no good of the reserve: the load is stored, nothing sold or given (P5). What it buys: the veterans keep working (F8) at the lowest burn we have and bring no iron. min_left keeps 30,000 in the belt; at most 10 ships on one belt (routes.py check). To be read at the next turn: credits per ship-hour against Hamal's -391 (briefing 05:31 UTC) and whether ice gives Mining XP.
